title: Malaysian-Style Beef Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew made with tender beef, crunchy carrots, and aromatic spices.
instructions: 1. Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
2. Add the beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.
3. Add the onion and garlic to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
4. Stir in the curry powder and cook for 1 minute.
5. Add the beef back into the pot, along with the carrot, fish sauce, soy sauce, chicken broth, and water.
6. Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
7. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
8. Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs, if desired.
